title: The Meghalaya Local Fund (Audit) Act, 2021 (Act No. 5 of 2021)
full_text: The Meghalaya Local Fund (Audit) Act, 2021 (Act No. 5 of 2021) Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20215 Act Number: 5 Enactment Date: 2021-03-23 Act Year: 2021 Short Title: The Meghalaya Local Fund (Audit) Act, 2021 (Act No. 5 of 2021) Long Title: An Act to provide for and to regulate the Audit of the Local Funds under the management or control of certain Local authorities in the State of Meghalaya.
